title: Groups

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.openHint: Every member sees the group and joins or leaves it on their own, on their dashboard under Personal.
visibility.visibleHint: Every member sees the group and who is in it. The lead or an admin adds members.
visibility.privateHint: Only the group's members, its lead and those who manage groups see it.

notFound: This group does not exist (any more) or you can't see it.

functions.empty: No function is filled in this group. Create group functions (for example Coach) under Members › Functions.

default.label: New members join this group
default.hint: Applies to everyone who joins from now on. Existing members aren't moved.

roles.label: Gives the roles
roles.openHint: An open group gives no roles: anyone could join it.
roles.hint: Everyone in the group holds these roles for the whole club while they're in it. Admin roles can't be used here.

tiers.label: Members of these tiers
tiers.hint: Anyone on one of these tiers is in the group. When their tier changes, their group changes too.
